purpose: Backfill first-pass Source Card anchors for current paper strong-claim falsifiers and C1/C2 priority-domain falsifier rows, so every current falsifier family has a traceable evidence role, allowed use, transfer boundary and next review action.

currentLimitations: This is source-anchor backfill, not full field-level Source Card extraction.
This register binds evidence roles and transfer boundaries; it does not validate every scientific claim.
One source anchor may cover a family of falsifiers, but later full Source Cards must split exact claim, variable, endpoint, population and uncertainty fields.
External URLs are provenance anchors; local audits check structure and coverage, not live web availability.

sourceAnchors.title: Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe
sourceAnchors.transferBoundary: Supports mechanism taxonomy only; it does not prove any individual intervention extends lifespan or healthspan.
sourceAnchors.localUse: Map molecular, cellular and systemic aging domains to variable families and downgrade conditions.

sourceAnchors.title: The Hallmarks of Aging
sourceAnchors.transferBoundary: Historical taxonomy support only; later evidence and domain-specific Source Cards are required before intervention claims.
sourceAnchors.localUse: Provide baseline source-anchor continuity for core aging mechanism domains.

sourceAnchors.title: DNA methylation GrimAge strongly predicts lifespan and healthspan
sourceAnchors.transferBoundary: Supports observational biomarker and risk-estimator framing; it does not prove that changing the biomarker changes mortality.
sourceAnchors.localUse: Anchor biological-age clock falsifiers and the rule that biomarker improvement is not sufficient for longevity claims.

sourceAnchors.title: Induction of pluripotent stem cells from mouse embryonic and adult fibroblast cultures by defined factors
sourceAnchors.transferBoundary: Supports induction of pluripotency in cells; it does not support whole-body rejuvenation or clinical anti-aging use.
sourceAnchors.localUse: Anchor cellular-reprogramming domain claims and the need to distinguish age reset from identity loss.

sourceAnchors.title: In Vivo Amelioration of Age-Associated Hallmarks by Partial Reprogramming

sourceAnchors.title: Hallmarks of Cancer: New Dimensions

nonClaims: This register does not complete full Source Cards for every paper, domain or falsifier.
This register does not prove any scientific, medical, engineering, AI or physics claim true.
This register does not permit individual death-date prediction, individual medical advice or individual intervention ranking.
This register is a local traceability gate that prevents current strong claims and priority falsifiers from lacking source-anchor provenance and transfer boundaries.
